notes: Mid-chapter rungs of ladders\Stray.json: the harness installs the rung's save as slot 3 (save_slot); 게임 시작 > slot 3 > 계속 (the slot's last checkpoint) > loading (load_wait_s) > Esc: the pause menu is the loaded marker > Esc (resume) > play ~3 min > pause > up (나가기) > 예 (to the main menu) > 나가기 > 예. Checkpoints and images are Stray-chapter's (recorded live 2026-10-03, runs\discover\stray-ch; see its notes). Continue of the ending save (slot1-controlroom) took ~6 s from Enter to the scene (black, no loading screen), warm cache; a save in another level takes longer, so load_wait_s defaults to 20 and the pause-menu check waits up to 60 s more (Esc every 6 s). The pause menu is 재개 / 설정 / 나가기 before the level's first checkpoint and 재개 / 설정 / 마지막 체크포인트 다시 불러오기 / 나가기 after it; up from 재개 is 나가기 in both. It opens during cutscenes too, and sometimes by itself (seen twice after 15-20 min): the steps press Esc when pause_menu shows between play segments. Never 지우기 in the slot submenu (deletes the slot). Keys: arrows move menu cursors (white box / white text = selected), Enter select, Esc back/pause, W/A/S/D walk, Space jump (only where the game offers it), mouse camera. Other keys are unverified: random play stays on W/A/S/D/Space/mouse. Dialogs (orange band) default to 아니요; 예 is right of it.

steps.note: slot 3 is the test slot the harness installed the rung's save into; slot 1 (the user's Control Room save) and slot 2 are never opened. slot3_selected is the selected card's left border + glow (thumbnail-independent)
the submenu (계속 / 챕터 선택 / 지우기) opens under the selected card: slot3_continue_selected only matches under slot 3, so a submenu under slot 1 or 2 stops the run here before any Enter
loaded marker: Esc opens the in-game pause menu (재개 preselected, 3 or 4 items); Esc again resumes

w a s d space w w
